summary: Windows postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote payload from anonymous file host
details: The package is a typosquat of @rbxts/services (extra hyphen in scope) and copies the roblox-ts author/homepage metadata. scripts/postinstall.js is hex-obfuscated and Windows-gated: sensitive identifiers (https, child_process, spawn, powershell, Expand-Archive, cmd,.exe, %LOCALAPPDATA%) are hidden with \x escapes, and the download URL is stored as a base64 literal that decodes to https://files.catbox.moe/9bppy2.zip. On Windows install, the script downloads that ZIP into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer, uses PowerShell Expand-Archive to unpack it, and launches any extracted.exe via cmd /c start /b detached and hidden. Every developer running npm install on Windows executes attacker-controlled code from an anonymous file host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
